text:
Devin: AM async — what I did: finished AZ pricing diff overlay, applied partial tagging to gpu-pool-tilt, ran a quick capacity calc for the next 6h (results below). Blockers: quota bump for eu-west1 spot pool still pending INF-3421; can’t prewarm more than +4 nodes. Today: follow up with cloud-requests and open a small canary for q2 quantized models.

Sasha: saw INF-3421 on my queue, pinged cloud-ops and added justification; estimate 2-4h for approval.

Leo: rolled a small drain on gpu-node-ams-03 to test spot fallback, saw a 2s cold-start spike on the serving runtime. Filing PR #4892 to add warmup cache on restart. Repro commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-ams-03
kubectl drain gpu-node-ams-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data\```

Marta: FYI cost team asked for token-level breakdown for the canary; shared dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dash/model-rollup?canary=4892

provisioning-bot: Capacity alert: eu-west1 spot pool at 82% utilization, buffer target 20% => headroom -2 nodes. (auto-scaler paused for recent quota ops)

Devin: temporary plan: lower canary parallelism to 2, enable prefix cache for canary routes, and request emergency +2 quota until INF-3421 clears.

Sasha: I'll escalate to cloud-provider support and add emergency justification. @Marta can you attach the cost note to INF-3421?

Marta: done. attached cost/latency delta and test prompts. :white_check_mark:

Leo: I can land PR #4892 by EOD if no major comments. Can someone review? @Devin @Sasha

Devin: will review in 30m.

Sasha: quick question — any objections to using reserved prewarm on dedicated pool for a 30m window during canary? saves spot churn.

Marta: fine by finance if we tag it to the canary cost center.

Devin: no objections. Go ahead but keep it scoped to 30m and track.

Sasha: created ticket INF-3421-urgent and added cloud support case ID: 99321. pinging infra-tilt for prewarm.

Leo: ack. will reduce canary concurrency and push image tag redwood/serve:canary-4892

Marta: leaving a note — if quota not approved within 1h we fallback to a smaller test dataset to keep regression checks alive.

provisioning-bot: Update: eu-west1 quota request 99321 moved to approved state pending billing verification.

Devin: sweet. I'll spin up +2 reserved nodes for 30m after approval, then run the 30m regression. Post results here.

Sasha: thanks team. any other quick blockers? otherwise 👍

Leo: none from me.

Marta: all good.
